chapter: Youth, the road and arrival in California
title: The Black and White Revue road show
summary: As a teenager he joined a segregated vaudeville show that folded after Harrisburg and Cleveland.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: But years later... I was talking about Charlie Parker and Erroll Garner. But way before that, while I was still in school...

...a show that left New York called The Black and White Revue, and for some date they needed a bass player. At this time I didn't have a bass; I had a tuba. So they hired me, and we got as far as Cleveland. I'll tell you about the show. Now, "Black and White Revue" means just what it says.
There was a Black part of the show and a White part of the show.

Yes. We'd go on separately. The same band played for both parts, but the White part of the show would go on first and the Black part would go on second. So it didn't last very long. I think we played Harrisburg and Cleveland, and that was the end of that...
What was the show? Was it dancers, singers?
